title: Metamorphoses
identity: Billaudot GB6204 identifies Naulais’s Métamorphoses for alto saxophone and piano, duration 6:45, with publisher classification “Moyennement difficile (cycle 2).” A Luxembourg public conservatory syllabus includes the work in its alto-saxophone/piano study repertoire. The French publisher cycle and Luxembourg syllabus are reported as their own systems.
